product_metadata.title: FANTESTICRYAN Small Glass Coffee Nuts Canister Airtight Storage Jar Petal Decorative Container with Bamboo Lid Metal Handle Easy to Grasp 700ml, 23 FL OZ (Set of 2)
features: FANTESTICRYAN Glass Storage Canister is made of high quality borosilicate glass, which is lead-free, BPA free, dishwasher safe, food-grade storage. It comes with an airtight bamboo lid and a metal handle, that is sturdy, durable and easy for daily use. Please make sure they are small-sized storage jars.

Petal-like design makes the Glass Container unique beauty, so that it is not only a storage jar, but also can be used as a home and kitchen decor jar. The widen mouth is typically designed for easy cleaning without brushes.

Each Glass Jar holds 700ml (23 FL OZ) liquid or 0.55 lbs (250g) Coffee Beans. It is perfect to store and display all manner of dry foods such as coffee beans, tea,cereal, homemade chocolate, candy etc. The sealed design can prevent moisture in air, keeps foods fresh longer.

PACKING INCLUDED: TWO 700ml glass jars (1*Oval + 1*Conical) Dimensions for the Oval Glass Jar: 11.5cm (4.5'') X 9cm (3.5'') X 8.5cm (3.3''); Taper Glass Jar: 11.5cm (4.5'') X 11cm (4.3'') X 8.5cm (3.5''); Opening for both Jar: 8.5cm (3.3''); Weight for each Jar: 300g
The vintage glass jars are carefully packaged with nice box that can be given as gifts to family or friends for Housewarming, Thanksgiving, Christmas etc.
